choice: Reject RT-DETR COCO as a bank-semantic path without primitive annotations. Compare requested CPU backend on the existing permitted Qwen GGUF; no direct label classifier.
hypothesis: Changing offload/backend may change exact primitive-fact correctness. Only a complete text gate permits a synthetic visual-facts test with deterministic state mapping.
gate: All six text responses exact valid JSON with normal stop. Then all three visual fact responses exact and deterministically mapped correctly. Otherwise close; no adaptive prompt, extra seed, images after text failure, bank or dataset split reads.
limits: CPU flags are a requested backend contrast, not an independently audited implementation. Same binary, weights, template and quantization; cause remains non-identifiable. Small synthetic facts do not validate bank roles, event types, rules or a camera.
privacy: Only generated images; no raw response/prompt/native logs persisted, no cloud inference, bank data, annotations, notes, TRAIN, TUNE or HOLDOUT. Loopback, ephemeral fixed test value, owned cleanup.
